claims.head: Active D vs. Forward-led
claims.body: On shots from defensemen, Columbus is one of the league’s best, but Utah is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Watch the Blue Jackets’ defensemen jump into the play.

claims.head: The Mammoth’s edge in shots from in close
claims.body: The Mammoth are near the top of the league for shots from in close, and the Blue Jackets are near the bottom. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one. Shots from in close tend to be the more dangerous ones.

CBJ.head: A slightly uphill night for the Blue Jackets
CBJ.body: Utah has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Columbus has home-ice advantage. The Blue Jackets’ best way to tip it is getting good looks.

UTA.head: Leaning the Mammoth’s way
UTA.body: Utah has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Columbus has home-ice advantage. The Blue Jackets can still swing it if they get good looks.
